thread:
incident-bot: P1 Alert — high error rate for tenant Lucid Energy (acct:LUC-924). 5xx on /v1/generate and embeddings. Triggered autoscale fallback. Paging oncall @Erica Chen. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/serve-errors

Erica Chen: I'm on it — joining now. Starting triage, will collect logs and top traces.

Samir Patel: Noted, I'm standing by for customer comms. Which endpoints exactly?

Erica Chen: Primarily /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Error spike started ~2024-11-08T13:03:20Z, sustained errors ~13:03:20–13:07:10Z. Rolling 5xx across two EU dedicated pools.

Maya Brooks: I can draft a tailored status for Lucid Energy once we confirm affected features (dashboards vs batch ingest). @Oliver can you pull their contact matrix?

Oliver Diaz: Lucid contacts: ops@lucid-energy.com (primary), eng-oncall@lucid-energy.com (secondary), AM: rachel@lucid-energy.com. Oncall window shows daytime US/EU overlap. Phone: +44 20 7946 0xxx.

Luis Gomez: Quick check — we have a degraded worker pool that failed to accept new streams. Kernel OOMs on g4dn-ampere-3 in eu-west-1 noted. Restarted nodes are back but KV cache warmup is slow.

Erica Chen: Actions so far:
- Restarted 3/8 workers in pool eu-west-1-gp2
- Forced fallback to cheaper variant (redwood/llama-7b-q4) for non-critical routes
- Enabled prefix-KV bypass for Lucid's high-priority routes to reduce cache pressure

Samir Patel: Ok — for customer-facing message we should be explicit: impacted endpoints, approximate window, mitigation in progress, and ETA for full recovery. Keep it short.

Maya Brooks: Draft status page blurb (please review):
```
Summary: We are investigating increased 5xx errors affecting text generation and embeddings for a subset of enterprise customers.
Impact: Customers may see failed or delayed generation/embedding requests. Lucid Energy (acct:LUC-924) is confirmed impacted.
Mitigation: We restarted workers and applied temporary routing to fallback models; requests are gradually recovering.
ETA: Continued monitoring. We expect stabilization within 30–45 minutes; further details to follow.
```

Erica Chen: Approved for status page with small edits. Change "subset of enterprise customers" -> "a small number of dedicated deployments".

Maya Brooks: Updated. Customer email draft for Lucid Energy (tailored):
```
Subject: Brief outage affecting generation & embeddings — Lucid Energy (LUC-924)

Hi Rachel / Lucid team,

We are investigating an elevated rate of 5xx errors impacting text generation and embeddings between 13:03–13:07 UTC today. This affected some requests to your dedicated deployment and may have resulted in failed or delayed responses in your dashboards and ingestion pipelines.

What we did: restarted affected workers, applied temporary routing to stable model variants, and prioritized your high-priority routes to reduce latency.

Current status: Traffic is recovering; we expect full normalization within ~30 minutes. We will follow up with a short RCA and any suggested mitigations for resiliency (e.g., model fallbacks, request retries with idempotency).

If you see persistent errors please escalate to eng-oncall@lucid-energy.com and reply to this thread so we can connect directly.

Apologies for the disruption — we know uptime is critical and are treating this with high priority.

— Redwood Support
```

Oliver Diaz: Rachel (AM) looped in via email and also pinged on Slack — she acknowledged and asked for a short status page link.

support-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1777777001 — "Investigating; mitigation in progress" :rotating_light:

Erica Chen: Small ops note: watch KV cache warmup for next 20m. If we see >2% error rate re-escalate to infra-sre.

Luis Gomez: Adding metrics to the incident dashboard. Top traces show spike in attn kernel latency before OOM. Dump attached to the incident runbook.

Samir Patel: Next steps for comms: 1) Send tailored email to Lucid (Maya to send), 2) Post status page update (done), 3) Follow up with RCA and suggested configs for fallback/quantization.

Maya Brooks: Sending the email now. Will mark in the CRM and cc the AM.

Erica Chen: Oncall handoff plan: I'll run until stabilization ~13:40 UTC, then hand off to Luis for RCA and follow-up. If anything regresses before handoff ping @oncall-sre.

Samir Patel: Thanks team. Please pin the customer-tailored email in the incident doc and include the contact list in the final comms. Also capture the model variant used during fallback for billing reconciliation.

Erica Chen: Noted. I'll update the incident doc with model_variant: redwood/llama-7b-q4 and worker_ids restarted.

support-bot: Incident status changed -> "Monitoring" at 13:25:45 UTC.

Maya Brooks: Lucid replied: "Thanks, we see reduced errors now. Please share RCA when available." :thumbsup:

Erica Chen: Closing notes for thread prep: compile timeline, customer impact table (requests failed, sample trace ids), and mitigation steps. I will attach a concise RCA draft by EOD.

Samir Patel: Great. Leaving this thread open for RCA attachment. If resolved fully, please update last_message_ts accordingly.
